metadata.description: Official Lazybird plugins: AI speech, voiceovers and video, voice cloning and voice design for agents.

plugins.name: lazybird
plugins.description: Speech, voiceovers and video for AI agents: turn text or SSML into natural speech, build multi-voice voiceovers and videos with stock footage, music and on-screen text, export MP4, MP3 and SRT subtitles, share by link, clone a voice from a sample, or design one from a description. Lazybird API.
